answer: The ferrous report makes public the merge explicitly at each juniper. Each collapsed cluster gets one whisper weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, a hostile operator who spins up 241 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 153 times the capital for one share. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 5 times over for the same share of the pool. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
